finding.claim: The CSS url filter only checks direct children of a property for :url/:bad_url, so a url() nested inside an allowed function such as symbols() survives sanitization and can cause a remote resource fetch from a sanitized style attribute.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled style attribute on any allowed element, e.g.
finding.sink: Sanitized style attribute emitted to the browser (scrub.rb:145), which may fetch the remote image.

trace.note: scrub_css parses the style with Crass.parse_properties
url_flags check inspects only direct children of the property; a :function child is not flagged
property allowlist accepts list-style-type (safelist.rb:669); shorthand prefix check also admits any background-/border-/margin-/padding- property
Crass::Parser.stringify emits the whole function including the nested url token
sanitized tree serialized into the style attribute

finding.guards_checked: Top-level url/bad_url check (bypassed for nested tokens); property name allowlist; function allowlist; Crass re-parse with .first (keeps the whole declaration). Not verified by execution: browser support for symbols() in list-style-type.

finding.claim: Loofah::Helpers.sanitize removes form elements only when they are direct children of the fragment, so nested forms survive sanitization.
finding.source: Any HTML string passed to Loofah::Helpers.sanitize, e.g.
finding.sink: Returned HTML contains a working form, enabling phishing-style UI injection.

trace.note: scrub!(:strip) keeps form because form is in ACCEPTABLE_ELEMENTS (safelist.rb:89)
xpath("./form") matches only direct children of the fragment
to_s returns the HTML including nested forms

finding.guards_checked: Strip safelist (permits form); ./form removal (direct children only). Likely inherited from upstream Loofah.

finding.claim: The local-href restriction for SVG elements keys on the lowercase name textpath, but the HTML5 parser emits textPath in camelCase, so non-fragment href values on textPath are not stripped by this rule.
finding.sink: Non-local href retained on a textPath element that the code intends to restrict to local references.

trace.note: SVG_ALLOW_LOCAL_HREF.include?(node.name) compares against the element name
downcasing adds lowercase variants, not camelCase, so the mismatch remains
generic URI check still runs; https is allowed

finding.guards_checked: URI protocol allowlist (https permitted); metahelper downcasing (does not cover camelCase). Impact not demonstrated; parser camelCase output not verified.
